$howto: Copy this file to entries/<your-kebab-slug>.json — the filename is your entry id. Remove the $howto line. Files starting with _ are ignored.
oneLiner: What it is and why it's good, in ≤140 characters.
builtWith: e.g. Claude Code + Sonnet · Cowork · API agent — say the model and surface
repo: https://github.com/you/your-project — optional, but required for the Stars board
screenshot: assets/<your-slug>.png or a full https URL — optional
enteredAt: YYYY-MM-DD — the date of your PR
